candidates.economic_mechanism: Simultaneous directional movement across BTC, ETH, and SOL can reflect broad capital or risk-flow rebalancing rather than single-asset noise; when dispersion stays contained, that common flow may persist for several hours.
candidates.hypothesis: A synchronized, low-dispersion 6-hour directional breadth impulse across the fixed BTC/ETH/SOL basket has positive same-direction after-cost expectancy over the next 6 hours.

signal_rules.direction_gate: all three 6h returns have the same non-zero sign

execution_rules.entry: next completed bar open after signal
execution_rules.overlap: ignore new signals while basket position is open
execution_rules.stop: none in cheap screen; fixed-hold falsification only

candidates.distinctness_note: Synchronous breadth basket; not BTC-follower underreaction and not compression/range breakout.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Short-horizon idiosyncratic overshoots in ETH or SOL relative to the broad BTC factor can mean-revert as arbitrage and portfolio rebalancing restore the prior factor relationship.
candidates.hypothesis: Extreme 6-hour ETH/BTC or SOL/BTC beta residuals revert after costs when traded as a beta-hedged pair using only pre-signal rolling estimates.

signal_rules.beta_input: hourly close-to-close returns ending at t
signal_rules.entry_gate: abs(residual_zscore) >= 2.0 and rolling follower/BTC return correlation >= 0.60

execution_rules.direction: opposite residual sign in follower; BTC hedge sized by frozen rolling beta
execution_rules.overlap: one open pair per follower; same-follower signals ignored until flat
execution_rules.gross_notional: 1.0 follower leg plus abs(beta) BTC hedge leg

candidates.distinctness_note: Opposite economic sign from residual-momentum lane; beta-hedged reversion, not cross-sectional continuation.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Persistent price-body direction accompanied by unusually large quote-volume participation can proxy sustained aggressive demand or supply; short continuation may survive after the flow is visible.
candidates.hypothesis: A four-hour signed-volume pressure burst with consistent candle direction and close-location confirmation has positive same-direction 3-hour after-cost expectancy.

signal_rules.direction_consistency: at least 3 of last 4 completed bars share aggregate sign

execution_rules.overlap: one position per asset; ignore overlapping same-asset signals

candidates.distinctness_note: Transparent OHLCV participation proxy; continuation and extreme-range exclusion, not high-volume shock reversion.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Large multi-hour price drift without normal trading participation is less likely to reflect durable information and may partially reverse when ordinary liquidity returns.
candidates.hypothesis: An unusually large 8-hour move formed on low quote-volume participation and without extreme hourly range has positive opposite-direction 6-hour after-cost expectancy.

execution_rules.overlap: one position per asset; ignore overlapping same-asset signals

candidates.distinctness_note: Requires low participation across 8h and excludes shock-like range expansion; opposite of rejected high-volume/wide-range one-hour shock setup.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Crypto weekend liquidity is often thinner and institutionally different from weekday liquidity; sufficiently large weekend dislocations formed on depressed participation may partially normalize when weekday liquidity returns.
candidates.hypothesis: A large low-participation weekend move from Friday 22:00 UTC through Sunday 23:00 UTC has positive opposite-direction after-cost expectancy during the first 12 hours of Monday UTC.

signal_rules.measurement_window: Friday 22:00 UTC close to Sunday 23:00 UTC close

execution_rules.overlap: maximum one position per asset per calendar week

candidates.distinctness_note: Fixed UTC calendar/liquidity-handoff mechanism, not generic shock reversion.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Persistent execution programs can create short serial correlation, but extreme-volatility shocks are often unstable; continuation may be most reliable in a predeclared moderate-volatility band.
candidates.hypothesis: Three consecutive same-direction hourly returns in a moderate realized-volatility regime have positive same-direction 3-hour after-cost expectancy.

signal_rules.direction_gate: last 3 completed hourly close-to-close returns all strictly positive or all strictly negative
signal_rules.vol_regime: 24h realized volatility between trailing 90d 35th and 70th percentiles
signal_rules.participation_guard: current quote_volume between trailing_30d 40th and 90th percentiles

execution_rules.overlap: one position per asset; ignore overlapping same-asset signals

candidates.distinctness_note: Time-series autocorrelation in moderate volatility; no compression, range breakout, follower lag, or cross-sectional rank.

candidates.economic_mechanism: In a demonstrably low-efficiency range regime, repeated auctions toward a recent range edge can mean-revert because price discovery is two-sided rather than directional.
candidates.hypothesis: When 24-hour price efficiency is low, a close in the outer 10% of the prior 48-hour range on non-extreme volume has positive opposite-direction expectancy toward the range midpoint.

execution_rules.take_profit: exit at next bar open after a completed bar close crosses the frozen prior-range midpoint
execution_rules.stop: exit at next bar open after a completed bar high/low breaches entry by 1.0 * ATR14 against position
execution_rules.overlap: one position per asset; ignore overlapping same-asset signals

candidates.distinctness_note: Low-efficiency auction/range mechanism; no large-return shock threshold or high-volume depletion condition.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Persistently positive perpetual funding transfers cash from long perp holders to short perp holders; a long-spot/short-perp hedge can harvest that carry without requiring directional price prediction when transaction costs and basis risk are controlled.
candidates.hypothesis: After three consecutive positive realized funding payments, entering a long-spot/short-perp hedge only when frozen trailing carry exceeds two-leg base costs has positive net carry over the next funding interval.

data_contract.source: Public OKX/Binance funding history plus OKX completed spot/perpetual candles; no paid provider
required_freeze_before_screen: realized funding rows with source timestamps

signal_rules.funding_history: three most recent realized funding payments available strictly before decision time
signal_rules.decision_time: first completed 1h bar after a realized funding timestamp

execution_rules.entry: next completed 1h bar open after signal
execution_rules.legs: long spot 1.0 notional and short perpetual 1.0 notional in same base asset
execution_rules.hold: until first completed 1h bar after the next realized funding payment
execution_rules.exit: close both legs at that bar open
execution_rules.overlap: one hedge per base asset; no overlapping carry positions
execution_rules.borrow_assumption: none; only positive-funding long-spot/short-perp direction is permitted

candidates.distinctness_note: Delta-neutral carry capture, not directional return prediction from funding; negative-funding spot-short path is excluded because borrow data are not frozen.
